summary: Supply the customer/customerId/fields params Google Directory + Drive endpoints require but the OpenAPI spec marks optional, across sync and the endpoint-mirror list commands.
reason: Google Directory users.list/groups.list require exactly one of customer/domain (an XOR the OpenAPI 'required' boolean cannot express, so both are marked required:false); the customer-scoped path endpoints (orgunits, chromeosdevices, mobiledevices, resources/calendars) require a customerId expressible as the 'my_customer' alias; Drive about.get requires 'fields' but declares no parameters. Without these the commands return HTTP 400. Genuinely API-specific, so a printed-CLI fix per AGENTS.md.
validated_outcome: Live: sync admin,admin-directory-v1-groups -> 219 records 0 errors; all six Directory list commands + drive-about return data; full live dogfood 477/477.
